items.title: XDroid360 – Dragon Age: Origins
items.content:
XDroid360 is an unofficial Android port of Xbox 360 games that runs games natively with Vulkan.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By udarmolota.

items.title: ZLAA – The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
items.content:
ZLAA is a native Android port of The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening for Switch that recompiles its ARM64 code to C and uses Vulkan for graphics.

For Nintendo Switch, Mobile. Runs on Android, Linux, Windows. By timbo722.

items.title: abyssport – Uncharted: Golden Abyss
items.content:
abyssport is a native Windows port of Uncharted: Golden Abyss that offers higher resolutions, wider screens, and 60 frames per second.

For PlayStation Vita. Runs on Windows. By SickSartori.

items.title: Super3D – Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury
items.content:
Super3D is a native PC port of Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury with ultrawide support and an in-game settings menu.

For Nintendo Switch. Runs on Windows. By vfjoo888.

items.title: ExaltDS – Fire Emblem: Awakening
items.content:
ExaltDS is a native Android port of Fire Emblem Awakening that runs the game code directly on your device, supporting dual screens and up to 4x resolution.

For Nintendo DS. Runs on Android. By teton-dev.

items.title: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian Android Port
items.content:
2 Ship 2 Harkinian Android Port is a port of 2 Ship 2 Harkinian to Android devices.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By Waterdish.

items.title: Shipwright-Android – Ship of Harkinian
items.content:
Shipwright-Android is a port of Ship of Harkinian to Android that supports touch controls or a controller.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By Waterdish.

items.title: ac3-decomp – Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
items.content:
ac3-decomp is a reverse engineering and Android port project for Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere, aiming for native controls and higher frame rates.

For PlayStation, Mobile. Runs on Android. By vzepec.

items.title: Black for Android
items.content:
Black for Android is a native port of the Xbox game Black to Android with touch controls, gyroscope aiming, and controller support.

For Xbox. Runs on Android. By UnknuwProjects.

items.title: pokefirered-dualscreen – Pokemon FireRed
items.content:
pokefirered-dualscreen is a native Android dual-screen port of Pokemon FireRed with a two-screen interface and touch battle menus.

For Game Boy Advance, Mobile. Runs on Android. By venom13.

items.title: reblue-android – Blue Dragon
items.content:
reblue-android is a native Android port of Blue Dragon with a live second screen for dual-screen consoles.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By zackfairestar-debug.

items.title: Naruto Recomp – Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 Full Burst
items.content:
Naruto Recomp is a native PC and Android port of Naruto Shippuden Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 Full Burst, built with ReXGlue.

For Xbox 360, Mobile. Runs on Android. By wizydeka-lang.

items.title: DOA3 – Dead or Alive 3
items.content:
DOA3 is a native Android port of Dead or Alive 3 with support for gamepad and on-screen controls and adjustable resolutions.

For Mobile. Runs on Android, Windows. By Wannamingo.

items.title: mw2-recomp – Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2
items.content:
MW2 Recompiled is a native Android port of Modern Warfare 2 that includes the campaign, Special Ops, and multiplayer.

For Xbox 360. Runs on Android. By yassinsolim.

items.title: ACGC-Android-Port – Animal Crossing
items.content:
ACGC-Android-Port is an Android port of Animal Crossing built on the ac-decomp decompilation with a touch overlay and HD texture pack support.

For GameCube, Mobile. Runs on Android. By zwaetschge.

items.title: Catherine: Full Body PC Port
items.content:
Catherine: Full Body PC Port is a native Windows and Linux port of Catherine: Full Body that supports 60 FPS and full keyboard and mouse controls.

For Nintendo Switch, PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By scottjco.

items.title: Zandatsu – Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance
items.content:
Zandatsu is a Metal Gear Rising Revengeance port to Android that runs the game natively on ARM64 with Vulkan rendering.

For Xbox 360, Mobile. Runs on Android. By dfdx047.

items.title: DW5-Android – Dynasty Warriors 5
items.content:
DW5-Android is a native Android port of Dynasty Warriors 5 for Xbox, built using the XboxXBE-Recomp SDK with Vulkan and SDL3.

For Xbox. Runs on Android. By datfooldive.

items.title: motorhead_rust
items.content:
motorhead_rust is a native PC port of the 1998 racing game Motorhead for Windows and Linux with sharper graphics and smoother frame rates.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By RadiatorTwo.

items.title: rustcoil – Recoil
items.content:
rustcoil is a PC port of Recoil that runs the game on modern Windows and Linux systems with widescreen and gamepad support.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By RadiatorTwo.

items.title: Re-Master-ed of Darkness – Master of Darkness
items.content:
Re-Master-ed of Darkness is a fan-made Android port of Master of Darkness for the Sega Master System with true 16:9 widescreen, no slowdowns, and new game modes.

For Sega Master System, Mobile. Runs on Android. By Juanmote.

items.title: MUA3 Recomp – Marvel Ultimate Alliance 3: The Black Order
items.content:
MUA3 Recomp is a native Windows port of Marvel Ultimate Alliance 3: The Black Order that runs at higher resolutions and frame rates.

For Nintendo Switch. Runs on Linux. By Jazzneo.

items.title: Wl4-recomp – Wario Land 4
items.content:
Wl4-recomp is a native port of Wario Land 4 for Android and Linux with save states and touch controls.

For Game Boy Advance. Runs on Android. By kalasyan.

items.title: CGT-XBERecomp – Conflict: Global Terror
items.content:
CGT-XBERecomp is a native PC port of Conflict: Global Terror for Xbox that supports Android and Linux with customizable graphics and controls.

For Xbox. Runs on Android. By PotatoRecomp.

items.title: crash2-native – Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
items.content:
crash2-native is a Linux port of Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back built on psxrecomp and recomp-ui with widescreen support.

For PlayStation. Runs on Linux. By Alejandro-Estrada-1.

items.title: wreckless-recomp – Wreckless: The Yakuza Missions
items.content:
wreckless-recomp is a Linux native port of the Xbox game Wreckless: The Yakuza Missions with higher resolutions and anisotropic filtering.

For Xbox. Runs on Linux. By AntAir267.

items.title: OpenMizzurna – Mizzurna Falls
items.content:
OpenMizzurna is a native PC port of Mizzurna Falls for Linux that rebuilds the game engine in C and uses Forth for game logic.

For PlayStation. Runs on Linux. By ArnautDaniel.

items.title: inFAMOUS Second Son: native Linux port
items.content:
inFAMOUS Second Son is a native Linux port of the PlayStation 4 game that runs the game's code directly on your CPU with a Vulkan renderer and supports mouse look and FSR 3.

For PlayStation 4. Runs on Linux. By aliveoutside.

items.title: bloodborne-linux
items.content:
bloodborne-linux is a native Linux port of Bloodborne that runs the game's own machine code directly, offering higher resolutions and frame rates.

For PlayStation 4. Runs on Linux. By bhuaysan.

items.title: Final Fantasy V (SNES Recomp)
items.content:
Final Fantasy V (NES Recomp) is a native recompilation of Final Fantasy V for Windows and Linux that allows for two players with one controller per port.

For Nintendo Entertainment System. Runs on Linux, Windows. By brainWave4.

items.title: Initial D Arcade Series launcher (rea-teknoparrot-initial-d-series) – Initial D Arcade Stage 3
items.content:
Initial D Arcade Series launcher is a tool for Windows and Linux that launches Initial D arcade games from version 1 to Season 5 with pad or wheel support and higher resolutions.

For Arcade. Runs on Linux, Windows. By AkitaOnRails.

items.title: SlugfestRecompiled – Ken Griffey Jr.'s Slugfest
items.content:
SlugfestRecompiled is a native PC port of Ken Griffey Jr.'s Slugfest for Nintendo 64 that supports widescreen in 3D scenes.

For Nintendo 64. Runs on Linux. By CalenCyr.

items.title: DiRT Rally launcher (rea-dirt-rally)
items.content:
DiRT Rally Launcher is a tool that runs DiRT Rally on modern Linux by providing necessary libraries and fixing crashes on new CPUs.

For PC. Runs on Linux. By AkitaOnRails.

items.title: Colin McRae Rally Modern (rea-colin-mcrae-recomp)
items.content:
Colin McRae Rally Modern is a native PC port of Colin McRae Rally with modern enhancements like higher resolutions and frame rates.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Linux. By AkitaOnRails.

items.title: Yoshi's Story Recomp
items.content:
Yoshi's Story Recomp is a PC port of Yoshi's Story for the Nintendo 64.

For Nintendo 64. Runs on Linux. By damobeanrod.

items.title: SF-pc-port-linux – Syphon Filter
items.content:
SF-pc-port-linux is a Linux port of Syphon Filter that runs the original PlayStation gameplay code natively and includes a Dossiers gallery.

For PlayStation. Runs on Linux. By dimovitus.

items.title: Warriors of the Eternal Sun: Easy on the Eyes
items.content:
Warriors of the Eternal Sun Easy on the Eyes is a Linux port of Warriors of the Eternal Sun for Sega Genesis with 240 Hz smooth motion and calm shading.

For Sega Genesis / Mega Drive. Runs on Linux. By gabbycat4.

items.title: Tenkaichi3Decomp – Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3
items.content:
Tenkaichi3Decomp is a native PS Vita port of Dragon Ball Z Budokai Tenkaichi 3 with working screen effects and touch controls.

For PlayStation 2, Mobile. Runs on Windows. By arielxflores.

items.title: arkos-sms – Super Mario Sunshine
items.content:
arkos-sms is a native Linux ARM64 port of Super Mario Sunshine for the Anbernic RG351P.

For GameCube. Runs on Windows. By eldandelion.

items.title: ACE6-Recomp-Linux-Binaries – Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation
items.content:
ACE6-Recomp-Linux-Binaries is a Linux port of Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation that includes custom Vulkan pipeline paths and 60 FPS timing hooks.

For PC. Runs on Linux. By DogeXH.

items.title: nfshp2-recomp – Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2
items.content:
nfshp2-recomp is a PC port of Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2 for Linux that supports widescreen and modern controller layouts.

For PlayStation 2. Runs on Linux. By gabegm.

items.title: eagle_five_recomp – Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War
items.content:
Eagle Five Recomp is a Linux port of Ace Combat 5 The Unsung War that focuses on performance and frame pacing with a graphical launcher.

For PlayStation 2. Runs on Linux. By Harold0777.

items.title: DEArmoredcoreV – Armored Core V
items.content:
DEArmoredcoreV is a native Linux port of Armored Core V that uses static recompilation and Vulkan rendering.

For Xbox 360. Runs on Linux. By GrayRats.

items.title: OunceRecomp – The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
items.content:
OunceRecomp is a native Linux port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time that runs the game's code directly on your PC.

For Nintendo Switch 2. Runs on Linux. By HookedBehemoth.

items.title: RogueSquadronRecomp – Star Wars: Rogue Squadron
items.content:
RogueSquadronRecomp is a native PC port of Star Wars: Rogue Squadron for Windows that supports widescreen and rumble.

For Nintendo 64. Runs on Windows. By Imadynamo.

items.title: Le Fétiche Maya 64bit
items.content:
Le Fétiche Maya 64bit is a native 64-bit port of Le Fétiche Maya for Windows and macOS, built by statically recompiling the Amiga version to C.

For Commodore Amiga. Runs on macOS, Windows. By Buyukcaglar.

items.title: OpenD2K – Dune 2000
items.content:
OpenD2K is a native port of Dune 2000 for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android with optional modern graphics and a 3D battlefield.

For PC. Runs on Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows. By OpenD2K.

items.title: Black (Xbox, 2006) — Native Linux Port
items.content:
Black is a native Linux port of the Xbox game Black, built using static recompilation with Vulkan graphics and SDL3.

For Xbox. Runs on Linux. By Katon Bagaskoro.

items.title: nfsmw-linux – Need for Speed: Most Wanted
items.content:
nfsmw-linux is a native Linux port of Need for Speed: Most Wanted Black Edition that runs directly on Linux with Vulkan support.

For Xbox. Runs on Linux. By Katon Bagaskoro.

items.title: Bloodborne Linux ARM64
items.content:
Bloodborne Linux ARM64 is a Linux port of Bloodborne for PlayStation 4 that runs the game's code natively and renders through Vulkan.

For PlayStation 4. Runs on Linux. By kitocato.
